name: OmniRank Execution-Ready Alpha Prompt Pack
objective: Complete the OmniRank Alpha implementation with fewer audit/fix loops by requiring schema discovery, vertical implementation, behavioral tests, self-audit, and completion gates inside every phase.

globalExecutionContract.sourceOfTruth: Current repository plus deployed Supabase schema
beforeEveryPhase: Inspect only named dependency files and actual migrations/types/routes used by that phase.
Resolve real database tables and columns before writing queries.
Identify existing implementation to extend instead of duplicate.
doneGate: Every acceptance item is PASS or explicitly external-live-pending.
No fake IDs, fake sources, fake metrics, placeholder factual conclusions or dead UI controls.
All DB field mappings match actual schema.
Full lint, test and build pass.

phases.title: Alpha Requirements Reconciliation
phases.purpose: Prevent scope loss by reconciling the original prompt pack and product objectives with the actual repository before continuing.
scope: Read omnirank-prompts.json, AGENTS.md, current migrations and main feature routes/types for P01-P07.
Create docs/alpha-requirements-matrix.json with one row per original requirement and status: implemented, partial, missing, deferred-by-product-decision, external-live-pending.
Do not reopen already-working architecture unless a missing item is required for the Alpha loop or for P08-P13 dependencies.
Create docs/alpha-gap-summary.md listing only alpha-critical missing items and the phase that will close each one.
acceptance: Every P01-P07 original prompt requirement is represented once in the matrix.
Every gap is assigned to OR-P07C, P08, P09, P10, P11, P12 or P13.
No duplicate competing implementation is proposed.
tests: Validate JSON schema/parseability of the requirements matrix.
phases.commit: docs(alpha): reconcile roadmap requirements before remaining phases

phases.title: Research Engine Final Closure
scope: Finish only remaining OR-P07 runtime defects.

Use exact existing schema columns for brand_profiles, brand_products, brand_audiences, brand_policies, brand_competitors, knowledge_sources, knowledge_documents, knowledge_chunks, evidence_sources, evidence_claims and articles.
Research modes must have observable behavior: Fast filters external/search-result/competitor/weak sources when configured; Standard surfaces conflicts; Deep enforces multi-source expectations.
Search intent must remain unresolved unless supported by actual research/opportunity evidence.
Reviewer brief transitions must be explicit and final states protected.
Migration 00013 must remain clean and undeployed until phase code passes.
acceptance: All ResearchEngine SELECT fields exist in actual schema.
Prepare Brief works with correct camelCase↔snake_case mapping.
Brand-scoped context queries fail closed.
Fast/Standard/Deep behavior is covered by behavioral tests.
Reviewer cannot approve/reject or demote finalized briefs.
No temporary helper scripts remain.
tests: Mocked tests must assert exact SELECT contracts for every context table.
Behavioral tests for mode filtering, DB failures and review transitions.
phases.afterPass: Commit/push. Do not deploy 00013 from Antigravity unless the autonomous runner has explicit Supabase deployment credentials and authorization; otherwise mark deployment pending and continue.

phases.title: OmniRouter and Content Generation
phases.objective: Add provider-neutral AI execution and turn an approved/reviewed Content Brief into validated structured article blocks without coupling OmniRank to one model vendor.
preflight: Inspect actual article schema/types/validator/editor, content_briefs/research APIs, brand/evidence schema and current environment conventions.
Resolve the exact canonical article envelope and supported block types from current code before generating anything.
Do not name providers in product-facing task contracts.
dataModel: Create forward migration with ai_tasks, ai_models, ai_routing_policies and ai_usage_events.
ai_tasks stores task code, org/brand/user/article/research references, requested quality/cost/privacy constraints, status, attempt count, timestamps and error metadata.
ai_models is operational inventory/config metadata, not secrets.
ai_routing_policies maps task codes and constraints to model tiers/capabilities.
ai_usage_events records provider/model, input/output/cache tokens where available, latency, estimated/actual cost, task id and outcome.
router: Create OmniRouter interface that accepts taskCode, structured input, quality tier, max cost, timeout, required output schema and privacy constraints.
Provider-specific adapters live only under the routing layer.
Implement deterministic mock adapter for tests/development.
Implement environment-configured adapter boundary for Cloudflare AI Gateway/OpenRouter/direct providers without hard-coding one as product truth.
Support timeout, retry/fallback policy, structured JSON validation and usage recording.
No API keys in browser responses, DB rows exposed to clients, logs or prompts.
generation: ARTICLE_DRAFT consumes an existing Research Project/Content Brief and only the relevant retrieved Brand Brain/policy/evidence/knowledge context.
Generate the current canonical structured article JSON, never canonical HTML.
Every generated block receives stable ID, origin/provenance and source/evidence refs where applicable.
Run the existing Article schema validator before persistence.
Persist as working document and create immutable milestone version where appropriate.
BLOCK_REWRITE may replace only the requested block/version context and must not overwrite unrelated user-edited blocks.
Do not silently invent citations/statistics/evidence. Unsupported claims remain marked or omitted.
apiUi: Authenticated endpoints for article draft generation, task status, block rewrite and safe retry.
Wire Content Studio AI actions to the real endpoints.
Show provider-neutral states such as Fast/Standard/High quality, not model names.
Expose task failure and retry without losing the user's article.
acceptance: No feature code outside adapters directly calls a provider SDK.
Structured outputs are schema validated before persistence.
Usage/cost/latency is recorded for every completed/failed AI task attempt.
One-block rewrite preserves all other blocks byte-for-byte/structurally unchanged.
Foreign-brand research/article references are rejected.
No source/evidence fabrication.
Missing live AI credentials uses deterministic mock adapter and marks external-live verification pending instead of blocking the phase.
tests: provider names absent from normal feature contracts.
phases.commit: feat(ai): implement OR-P08 OmniRouter and structured generation

phases.title: Quality, Review and Versioning
phases.objective: Implement the enforceable Verify → Optimize → Approve layer, binding approval to an immutable version and preventing policy/evidence violations from publishing.
preflight: Inspect actual article status enum, article_versions/review RPCs, Brand Policies, evidence model and current editor review panels.
Extend existing review/versioning instead of creating parallel approval systems.
dataModel: Add SEO/GEO/brand/evidence audit records, internal_link_suggestions, content_reviews, review_comments and approval_requirements using forward migration.
Preserve audit history; no destructive overwrite of completed audits/reviews.
workflow: Support lifecycle needed for Alpha: idea/researching/brief/drafting/ai_review/human_review/approved/scheduled/published/monitoring/refresh_recommended/archived, adapting existing enum through safe migration if necessary.
Any post-approval content edit creates/identifies a new unapproved version and prevents publishing it until approved.
Reviewer/Strategist/Admin authority follows existing role model.
Optional separation-of-duties setting prevents author self-approval when enabled.
gates: Statistics/citations requiring evidence must resolve to permitted same-brand evidence/source records.
Unsupported claims are visible and can block according to policy.
SEO/GEO/brand/evidence checks return actionable findings, not only opaque scores.
Internal link suggestions include destination, anchor, reason and location.
acceptance: Exact-version approval is DB-authoritative.
Editing after approval invalidates approval for the new content version.
Blocking policy violation cannot be bypassed by direct client update.
Reviewer/Writer/Strategist permissions enforced at DB/API level.
Quality panel in Content Studio uses real audit data.
phases.commit: feat(review): implement OR-P09 quality gates and exact-version approval

phases.title: WordPress Publishing
phases.objective: Publish only an approved exact article version to WordPress through a secure, idempotent integration while keeping structured JSON canonical.
preflight: Inspect actual article block schema and approved-version contract before writing renderer.
Create CMS adapter interface so WordPress is first implementation, not permanent architecture.
dataModel: Create integrations, protected credential references, cms_content_mappings and publishing_jobs if not already present.
Store only credential references/metadata in normal tables; secrets remain server-side encrypted/Vault/Workers Secrets.
wordpress: Retrieve/store published URL and remote post id.
renderer: Render sanitized WordPress-compatible HTML from the exact approved canonical structured version.
Support every Alpha block type currently in Article schema.
Never make returned WordPress HTML canonical article truth.
reliability: Publishing job idempotency key prevents duplicate posts on retry/concurrency.
Retries operate on existing cms mapping.
Publishing verifies approval still refers to the version being published.
acceptance: No credential returned to browser/AI/logs.
Unapproved/wrong-version publish denied.
Retry cannot create duplicate post.
Renderer fixtures cover all supported blocks.
If WordPress credentials are unavailable, adapter contract + mock server tests pass and live WordPress verification is marked external-live-pending.
tests: renderer snapshot/semantic tests for all block types.

phases.title: Growth Brain with GSC and GA4
phases.objective: Synchronize search/analytics data into local daily facts and convert it into explainable Growth Brain recommendations instead of querying Google on every screen load.
preflight: Inspect websites/articles/opportunities and current integration conventions.
Normalize URL/article mapping rules before recommendation logic.
dataModel: Create gsc_query_daily, gsc_page_daily, gsc_page_query_daily, ga4_landing_page_daily, content_performance_snapshots, content_health_assessments and growth_recommendations.
Unique keys make daily sync upserts idempotent.
integrations: Provider interfaces for GSC and GA4 with OAuth credential references.
Sync by date range with pagination, checkpointing and retry.
Persist local daily data; dashboards read local tables.
analysis: Content conflicts/cannibalization signals from available data.
Convert meaningful findings into explainable Opportunity/Growth recommendations with source metrics and dates.
acceptance: No dashboard-time dependency on live Google APIs.
Daily sync is idempotent.
Every recommendation retains metrics/date-window rationale.
No fabricated analytics.
Missing Google credentials uses fixtures/mocks and marks live verification pending.
phases.commit: feat(growth): implement OR-P11 GSC GA4 Growth Brain

phases.title: Automations, Billing and Cost Controls
phases.objective: Add safe Manual/Copilot/Autopilot orchestration, customer entitlements and internal cost accounting without allowing client-side bypass.
dataModel: Create plans, subscriptions and customer usage_events if absent.
Reuse P08 ai_usage_events as internal AI cost ledger; do not merge customer credits with token accounting.
automation: Inngest adapter/interface with deterministic local runner fallback.
Templates: Content Decay Watch, CTR Opportunity Watch, Internal Link Watch, Weekly Opportunity Report, Auto-Publish Approved Content.
Manual, Copilot and opt-in brand-scoped Autopilot.
Approval rules, confidence thresholds, max actions/day, exclusions and notification hooks.
Every automated action creates auditable workflow/run records.
billing: Customer-facing unit is Article Run, not tokens.
Server-side entitlement checks gate expensive actions and automation.
Local plan logic is tested before Stripe integration.
Stripe adapter handles subscription sync/webhooks idempotently when credentials exist.
No browser-supplied entitlement/plan value is trusted.
cost: Views/queries for AI cost per article, customer, provider/model and feature.
Track revenue/usage separately from provider cost.
acceptance: Autopilot cannot bypass approval/policy/publish gates.
Rate/action limits enforced server-side.
Webhook/retry idempotency.
Client cannot forge entitlement.
Missing Inngest/Stripe credentials does not block code completion; live checks marked pending.
phases.commit: feat(automation): implement OR-P12 workflows billing and cost controls

phases.title: Security Hardening and Alpha Acceptance
phases.objective: Close the Alpha loop and prove tenant isolation, safety, reliability, cost observability and the end-to-end user journey without adding major new features.
reconciliation: Update every original P01-P12 requirement to final status.
Implement any remaining alpha-critical missing item that blocks the full loop.
security: Dual-user/two-tenant RLS tests across critical tables/RPCs.
e2e: WordPress adapter publish (live if credentials, deterministic integration fixture otherwise)
GSC/GA4 sync (live if credentials, fixtures otherwise)
metrics: AI cost/Article Run from usage ledger
outputs: clear list of only true external-live-pending checks
acceptance: All alpha-critical requirements PASS.
No known cross-tenant leak.
No known approval/publishing bypass.
No duplicate-publish path under retry.
End-to-end Alpha journey passes with live integrations or deterministic contract fixtures.
No Beta feature started.
phases.commit: test(alpha): complete OR-P13 security and Alpha acceptance
